items.title: 基金爆倉反成加分題？「AI股神」遭重創  矽谷投資人反而搶著押注
items.title_en: Fund’s Margin Call Turns Into a Plus? ‘AI Stock God’ Smashed, Yet Silicon Valley Investors Rush to Bet
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資圈近期爆發的槓桿危機，非但沒有澆熄矽谷對新世代 AI 投資人的熱情，反而出現意外的「逆勢追捧」。
前 OpenAI 研究員 Leopold Aschenbrenner 旗下避險基金 Situational Awareness 近期因高槓桿與集中持股遭遇流動性危機，甚至被迫大幅減碼股票部位。
不過，根據《彭博》報導，基金爆發危機後短短幾天內，多名矽谷投資人反而主動接觸該基金，表達追加資金的興趣。
知情人士透露，Situational Awareness 目前暫未接受新資金，但投資圈對 Aschenbrenner 的信心並未因此明顯動搖。
紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）合夥人 Pat Grady 甚至公開表示，他認為 Aschenbrenner 仍將是未來很長一段時間內矽谷的重要人物。
分析指出，這起事件也凸顯出矽谷與華爾街對「高風險、高報酬」投資模式截然不同的評價標準：華爾街看到的是槓桿、集中持倉與風險管理失控；矽谷部分投資人看到的，卻是一名押注 AI 長期趨勢的投資人，在遭遇挫敗後重新出發的機會。

槓桿危機引爆強制平倉　基金仍保有逾百億美元資產

Situational Awareness 此次危機的導火線，是融資機構要求追加保證金。
面對流動性壓力，基金緊急出售大部分股票持倉，並將相關部位出售給 Citadel 創辦人 Ken Griffin 旗下的 Citadel，折價幅度超過 10%。
這場拋售也讓市場迅速意識到，Aschenbrenner 原本高度集中的 AI 投資策略，可能因槓桿放大而面臨劇烈的下行風險。
Aschenbrenner 隨後向投資人承認投資策略出現錯誤，並宣布全面解除基金槓桿。他將此次事件形容為一場「代價高昂」的經驗，但同時強調，這些教訓將成為基金未來發展的重要資產。
儘管遭遇猛烈衝擊，Situational Awareness 目前剩餘資產，包括私募投資在內，總價值仍約 100 億美元；更值得注意的是，基金今年迄今仍錄得約 80% 的正報酬。

矽谷反而力挺　「英雄敘事」蓋過爆倉陰影

在傳統金融市場，基金爆倉通常會嚴重打擊經理人的聲譽；但 Aschenbrenner 的情況卻出現不同結果。
風險投資機構 Redpoint Ventures 董事總經理 Logan Bartlett 表示，矽谷存在一種特殊的「英雄原型」，Aschenbrenner 這次遭遇挫敗，反而讓部分支持者產生更強的凝聚力。
知名創投人士 Elad Gil 也公開表示，他已首次申請投資 Aschenbrenner 旗下基金。
紐約大學 Stern 商學院兼任教授、Focus Investment Group 董事總經理 Gygmy Gonnot 則認為，這種截然不同的反應，源自矽谷與華爾街衡量成功的方式不同。
對矽谷而言，只要投資人押中了足以改變產業格局的技術趨勢，即使過程中承擔巨大波動，也可能被視為值得；但對華爾街而言，核心仍是如何控制風險、保住本金，同時取得合理的風險調整後報酬。

華爾街早有疑慮　集中持股與高槓桿成最大警訊

然而，從華爾街角度來看，Situational Awareness 此次遭遇的危機並非完全出乎意料。
S3 Partners 創辦人 Bob Sloan 直指，這檔基金同時具備高度集中、交易擁擠以及高槓桿三項特徵，而這三種風險一旦同時出現，很容易在市場反轉時形成連鎖反應。
事實上，在基金此次危機爆發之前，部分大型金融機構就已對其風險結構有所疑慮。
與許多成熟避險基金不同，Situational Awareness 的主要投資者是舊金山灣區的富裕個人與家族辦公室，而非大型退休基金或主權財富基金。
《彭博》先前報導指出，巴克萊在基金危機爆發前數週，曾以單一產業曝險過度集中為由，拒絕將 Situational Awareness 納入主經紀業務客戶。
據悉，摩根士丹利最初也曾因 Aschenbrenner 投資經驗不足而拒絕提供主經紀服務，但知情人士透露，該銀行後來改變態度，計畫在未來數週內與 Situational Awareness 建立主經紀關係。
另一方面，高盛、摩根大通與美國銀行則曾向該基金提供槓桿資金。

AI 基金成為高報酬競技場　7 月拋售潮放大風險

分析指出，Situational Awareness 所處的 AI 專注型避險基金市場，本身就是一個高報酬與高波動並存的戰場。
部分競爭對手同樣取得驚人績效。例如 Value Aligned Research Advisors 由來自貝萊德（BlackRock）與 Hudson River Trading 等機構的資深人士組成，截至 6 月底管理資產規模超過 260 億美元。
根據《彭博》取得的投資人文件，該公司旗下 AI 基金今年截至 6 月底的報酬率約 194%，同期標普 500 指數漲幅則不到 10%，兩者差距極為懸殊。
但高報酬同樣伴隨高風險。7 月 AI 類股遭遇拋售時，多家大型避險基金也受到衝擊。Millennium Management 當月下跌 2.1%，Point72 Asset Management 下跌 3.3%，而持股更為集中的 Altimeter Capital Management 則重挫 11%。
部分投資人甚至提前預判 Situational Awareness 可能遭遇強制拋售，並預先建立避險部位。

去槓桿只是第一步　Aschenbrenner 下一關仍是華爾街

分析人士認為，對 Aschenbrenner 而言，此次危機真正的考驗可能不是如何重新獲得矽谷投資人的支持，而是如何重新取得華爾街金融機構的信任。
他已宣布清除基金所有槓桿，現階段也不再透過銀行主經紀業務放大投資部位。
然而，問題在於，若希望重現今年早期的超高報酬，單靠自有資金可能限制投資規模與策略彈性。換言之，未來若要再次大舉押注 AI，Aschenbrenner 最終仍可能需要重新取得銀行融資與槓桿支持。
分析稱，這使他陷入一個微妙的局面。一方面，矽谷投資人仍相信他押注 AI 的長期眼光；另一方面，華爾街則會要求他證明自己能夠控制槓桿、降低持倉集中度，並建立更成熟的風險管理制度。
paras_en: The recent leveraged crisis erupting in the AI investment circle has not dampened Silicon Valley’s enthusiasm for the next‑generation AI investors; instead, it has sparked an unexpected “counter‑trend rally.”

Leopold Aschenbrenner, a former OpenAI researcher, runs the hedge fund Situational Awareness, which recently ran into a liquidity crunch because of high leverage and a concentrated stock portfolio, forcing the fund to dramatically cut its equity positions.
According to Bloomberg, within just a few days of the fund’s crisis, several Silicon Valley investors proactively reached out to the fund, expressing interest in adding capital.
Sources familiar with the matter say Situational Awareness has not yet taken new money, but confidence in Aschenbrenner within the investment community has not visibly wavered.
Sequoia Capital partner Pat Grady even publicly stated that he believes Aschenbrenner will remain a key figure in Silicon Valley for a long time to come.

Analysts note that the episode highlights the starkly different standards Silicon Valley and Wall Street apply to “high‑risk, high‑reward” investing: Wall Street sees leverage, concentration and loss of risk control; some Silicon Valley investors see a person betting on the long‑term AI trend who, after a setback, now has a chance to restart.
Leverage crisis triggers forced liquidation – the fund still holds over $10 billion in assets. The spark for Situational Awareness’s latest trouble was a margin call from its financing partners.
Facing liquidity pressure, the fund hurriedly sold most of its equity holdings, offloading the positions to Citadel, the firm founded by Ken Griffin, at a discount of more than 10 %.
The sell‑off quickly made the market aware that Aschenbrenner’s highly concentrated AI strategy could suffer severe downside risk when leverage amplifies losses.

Aschenbrenner later admitted to investors that the investment approach was flawed and announced a full unwind of the fund’s leverage. He described the episode as a “costly” learning experience, but stressed that the lessons will become valuable assets for the fund’s future development.
Despite the shock, Situational Awareness still has roughly $10 billion in assets left, including private‑equity holdings, and it has posted about an 80 % positive return year‑to‑date.

Silicon Valley backs the fund – the “hero narrative” overshadows the margin‑call shadow. In traditional finance, a fund’s collapse usually damages a manager’s reputation, but Aschenbrenner’s case has produced a different outcome.

Redpoint Ventures managing director Logan Bartlett said there is a special “hero archetype” in Silicon Valley, and Aschenbrenner’s setback has actually strengthened cohesion among some of his supporters.
Prominent venture investor Elad Gil also publicly announced that he has filed his first investment request for Aschenbrenner’s fund.
Gygmy Gonnot, a professor at NYU Stern and managing director of Focus Investment Group, believes the divergent reactions stem from the different ways Silicon Valley and Wall Street measure success.

For Silicon Valley, as long as an investor backs a technology trend that could reshape an industry, even massive volatility may be deemed worthwhile; Wall Street, however, remains focused on risk control, capital preservation, and achieving reasonable risk‑adjusted returns.
Wall Street had long harbored doubts – concentration and high leverage were the biggest red flags. From Wall Street’s perspective, the crisis at Situational Awareness was not entirely unexpected.

Bob Sloan, founder of S3 Partners, pointed out that the fund combined three risk factors – high concentration, crowded trading and high leverage – and when they appear together they can trigger a chain reaction in a market reversal.
In fact, before the crisis erupted, several large financial institutions had already raised concerns about the fund’s risk structure.
Unlike many mature hedge funds, Situational Awareness’s primary investors are wealthy individuals and family offices in the San Francisco Bay Area, not large pension funds or sovereign wealth funds.
Bloomberg previously reported that Barclays, weeks before the fund’s crisis, refused to onboard Situational Awareness as a prime brokerage client, citing excessive single‑industry exposure.

It is understood that Morgan Stanley initially declined to provide prime brokerage services because of Aschenbrenner’s limited investment experience, but insiders say the bank later changed its stance and plans to establish a prime brokerage relationship in the coming weeks.
On the other hand, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America have all provided leveraged financing to the fund.

AI funds have become a high‑return arena – July sell‑offs amplified risk. Analysts note that the AI‑focused hedge‑fund market, where Situational Awareness operates, is inherently a battlefield of high returns and high volatility.

Some competitors have also posted eye‑popping performance. For example, Value Aligned Research Advisors, staffed by veterans from BlackRock, Hudson River Trading and other firms, managed over $26 billion in assets as of the end of June.

According to investor documents obtained by Bloomberg, the AI fund run by that firm posted a roughly 194 % return through June, while the S&P 500 rose less than 10 % over the same period – a stark contrast.

But high returns come with high risk. When AI stocks were sold off in July, several large hedge funds felt the impact: Millennium Management fell 2.1 %, Point72 Asset Management dropped 3.3 %, and the more concentrated Altimeter Capital Management plunged 11 %.
Some investors even pre‑emptively predicted that Situational Awareness might face a forced liquidation and built hedges in advance.

De‑leveraging is only the first step – Aschenbrenner’s next hurdle remains Wall Street. Analysts say the real test for Aschenbrenner is not merely winning back Silicon Valley backing, but regaining the trust of Wall Street financial institutions.
He has announced that all leverage has been removed from the fund and that it no longer uses prime‑brokerage financing to amplify positions.

However, the problem is that if he wants to replicate the ultra‑high returns seen earlier this year, relying solely on internal capital may limit the size and flexibility of his strategies. In other words, a future large‑scale AI bet may still require renewed bank financing and leverage support.

Analysts say this puts him in a delicate position. On one hand, Silicon Valley investors still believe in his long‑term AI vision; on the other, Wall Street will demand proof that he can control leverage, reduce concentration, and build a more mature risk‑management framework.

items.title: 印能科技卡位雙陣營 今年營收估倍增、產能再增3成
items.title_en: InnoTech Positions Itself in Dual Camps, Revenue Expected to Double This Year, Capacity to Increase by Another 30%
paras: 印能科技 (7734-TW) 持續擴大客戶版圖，近期除受惠台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) CoWoS 及 SoIC 等需求放量，也傳出深耕多年的英特爾 (INTC-US) EMIB 平台開始出貨，隨著兩大晶圓代工陣營同步推進先進封裝，印能科技今年營運可望逐季走高，法人估，印能今年營收將翻倍，明年動能可望再更強。
印能科技目前設備月產能約 40 台，為因應客戶需求持續升溫，已啟動新一波擴產計畫，將原先廠房三樓空間建置為生產區，月產能可望增加約 10 多台，整體產能提升約 30-40%。
印能科技近年隨著台積電 CoWoS 製程產能不斷擴張，營收高速成長，且受惠台積電未來持續穩健擴充產能，印能需求也跟著提升，同時也傳出切入 SoIC 供應鏈，使用印能第三代設備，今年下半年已開始陸續出貨。
市場預估，台積電今年 SoIC 產能將在短短三年內增長 3 倍，今年底月產能約 2 萬片，明年可望倍增至 4 萬片，後年更上看 8 萬片，受惠客戶逐步拉升產能，印能相關設備明年放量幅度將更顯著。
隨著全球先進封裝產能緊俏，英特爾 EMIB 製程也獲得多家終端客戶青睞，傳出拿下多筆訂單，並啟動未來數年擴產計畫，印能科技耕耘 EMIB 製程多年，相關設備已在今年上半年少量出貨，後續可望隨英特爾 EMIB 產品推進而逐步放量，成為新動能。
除了既有先進封裝技術，印能科技也積極切入 CPO、FOPLP 及翹曲控制等新應用，尤其近來由於晶片及光罩尺寸持續放大，翹曲問題也成為新挑戰，印能科技推出 WSAS 產品因應，目前已在客戶驗證階段，最快第四季有機會取得進展。
paras_en: InnoTech (7734-TW) continues to expand its customer base. Recently it has benefited from increased demand for TSMC (2330-TW) (TSM-US) CoWoS and SoIC, and it is reported that the long‑time Intel (INTC-US) EMIB platform it has been cultivating is now shipping. As both major wafer‑foundry camps push advanced packaging forward, InnoTech’s operations are expected to rise quarter by quarter this year. Analysts estimate InnoTech’s revenue will double this year, with even stronger momentum anticipated next year.

InnoTech’s current equipment capacity is about 40 units per month. To meet rising customer demand, it has launched a new expansion phase, converting space on the third floor of its plant into a production area. This should add roughly ten more units per month, boosting total capacity by about 30‑40%.

In recent years, as TSMC’s CoWoS production capacity has continuously expanded, InnoTech’s revenue has grown rapidly. Benefiting from TSMC’s steady capacity expansion, demand for InnoTech’s equipment has risen, and the company is also reported to have entered the SoIC supply chain, using its third‑generation equipment, with shipments beginning in the second half of this year.

The market forecasts that TSMC’s SoIC capacity will triple within three years. By the end of this year, monthly capacity is expected to reach about 20,000 wafers, doubling to 40,000 wafers next year and potentially 80,000 wafers the year after, as customers gradually increase output. Consequently, InnoTech‑related equipment is expected to see a more pronounced volume increase next year.

With global advanced‑packaging capacity in short supply, Intel’s EMIB process has attracted multiple end‑customers, securing several orders and launching a multi‑year expansion plan. InnoTech has been developing EMIB technology for years, and its related equipment saw limited shipments in the first half of this year. Further volume growth is expected as Intel’s EMIB products advance, providing a new growth driver.

Beyond existing advanced‑packaging technologies, InnoTech is actively entering new applications such as CPO, FOPLP, and warp control. As chip and mask sizes continue to grow, warp has become a fresh challenge. InnoTech introduced its WSAS product to address this and is currently in customer verification, with the possibility of progress as early as the fourth quarter.

items.title: 記憶體大漲推升顯示卡迎第三波漲價潮 板卡廠平均出貨單價激增進補
items.title_en: Memory Surge Drives Third Wave of GPU Price Hikes, Board Makers See Average Shipment Prices Jump
paras: 由於記憶體價格持續走揚，顯示卡市場迎來今年第三波漲價潮，輝達等晶片大廠陸續調漲顯示卡晶片套裝售價約 2-3 成，帶動全球零售通路與批發市場價格急劇攀升，可望進一步推升華碩 (2357-TW)、微星 (2377-TW)、技嘉 (2376-TW) 等板卡廠平均出貨單價，為下半年獲利表現注入補丸。
全球最大電子產品批發市場深圳華強北近期出現顯卡價格一日一價急漲現象，部分熱門與高階型號數日內上漲人民幣數百元至上千元，漲幅超過三成，甚至連二手市場價格也同步走高，顯卡製造商微星已正式跟進華碩與技嘉腳步調高顯示卡出貨價格，最高調漲幅度突破 20%。
針對記憶體成本大漲對後市的影響，微星表示雖然記憶體供貨能見度僅約一個月且成本攀升，導致今年消費性市場出貨量可能下滑 10% 至 20%，但在同業嚴控毛利率不殺價且單價提升帶動下，對整體獲利表現仍有實質幫助。
技嘉則指出記憶體價格上漲確實對消費端需求造成壓力，但隨著人工智慧應用持續普及，將有效推升既有電腦設備的換機需求，下半年主機板與顯示卡業務展望仍保持審慎樂觀。
雖然研究機構預警記憶體合約價下半年仍有大幅上揚風險，且晶片原廠針對部分高成本高階顯卡採取延後上市或調整產能策略，但各板卡廠積極嚴控產品毛利率並隨時調整產品報價，市場預期價格調整效應將持續觀察至年底購物旺季，整體高附加價值產品組合將持續支撐板卡廠營運韌性。
paras_en: Due to the continued rise in memory prices, the graphics‑card market is experiencing its third wave of price hikes this year. Major chip makers such as Nvidia are gradually raising the price of GPU chip packages by about 20‑30%, which has sent retail and wholesale prices soaring worldwide and is expected to lift the average shipment price for board makers like Asus (2357‑TW), MSI (2377‑TW) and Gigabyte (2376‑TW), bolstering profit performance in the second half of the year.

Shenzhen’s Huaqiangbei, the world’s largest electronics wholesale market, has recently seen GPU prices jump dramatically day by day. Some popular and high‑end models have risen by several hundred to over a thousand yuan within a few days, an increase of more than 30%. Even second‑hand market prices have climbed. GPU maker MSI has officially followed Asus and Gigabyte in raising its shipment prices, with the highest increase exceeding 20%.

Regarding the impact of the memory cost surge, MSI said that although memory supply visibility is only about a month and costs are climbing, which could cause consumer‑market shipments this year to fall 10‑20%, the industry’s strict control of gross margins and the rise in unit prices will still provide a tangible boost to overall profitability.

Gigabyte noted that the memory price rise does put pressure on consumer demand, but the continued proliferation of artificial‑intelligence applications will effectively drive replacement demand for existing computer equipment. Consequently, the outlook for motherboard and GPU sales in the second half remains cautiously optimistic.

Although research firms warn that contract memory prices could still rise sharply in the second half and chip makers are delaying launches or adjusting capacity for some high‑cost, high‑end GPUs, board makers are tightly managing product gross margins and adjusting pricing as needed. The market expects price‑adjustment effects to be monitored through the year‑end shopping season, and the overall high‑value‑added product mix will continue to support the resilience of board makers’ operations.

items.title: AI浪潮遇能源地獄梗！全球斷供破10億桶 PIMCO揭3大節點封鎖 台灣受創深
items.title_en: AI Wave Meets Energy Hell: Global Supply Disruption Exceeds 1 Billion Barrels, PIMCO Reveals 3 Key Nodes Blocked, Taiwan Severely Affected
paras: 全球能源供應正面臨高度脆弱時刻，波斯灣、紅海與黑海等三大關鍵地理節點同時封鎖。知名固定收益資產管理機構 PIMCO（品浩）最新報告指出，受中東、烏克蘭與俄羅斯等多重地緣政治衝突影響，全球石油累計供應損失已超過 10 億桶，創下史上最大能源供應淨損失。隨著緩衝機制逐步耗盡，全球能源市場的容錯空間已降至零，市場正面臨更高的全球經濟衰退與滯脹型供給衝擊風險，PIMCO 並點名能源淨進口地區如歐洲、日本與台灣等受創將最為嚴重。

PIMCO 經濟學家衛艾婷（Tiffany Wilding）與大宗商品投資組合經理人 Greg Sharenow 分析，當前能源供應風險已擴及波斯灣、紅海與黑海等三大關鍵地理節點。其中，波斯灣航運再度接近停滯，荷姆茲海峽受阻導致每日近兩成全球石油供應受脅；紅海曼德海峽遭遇胡塞武裝攻擊，打擊沙烏地阿拉伯改道運往紅海的生命線；烏克蘭對俄羅斯煉油設施與出口港口的攻擊，則使俄羅斯加工量降至 20 多年來最低，進一步推升成品油價格溢價。
除了原油市場，汽油、柴油與航空燃油等成品油以及液化天然氣（LNG）同樣陷入緊縮。目前美國零售汽油價格已升至每加侖 4 美元以上，柴油突破 5 美元。PIMCO 強調，特別的是，當前全球正處於人工智慧（AI）浪潮，算力與資料中心爆炸性成長帶動電力與能源需求，加上記憶體與晶片等高耗能產業需求激增，進一步穩固並放大了能源市場的供需失衡壓力。
更棘手的是，過去緩和市場衝擊的緩衝機制已近耗盡。全球戰略石油儲備已釋出約 3 億桶，使美國戰略儲備降至 1983 年以來新低，商業庫存亦處於數十年低點。與此同時，全球最大原油進口國中國透過提領庫存與減少進口將採購量大幅砍半，一旦中國重新進場補庫，供應短缺問題將更加尖銳。
PIMCO 警告，這是一場典型的滯脹型供給衝擊，實質能源價格上漲等同對全球消費者課徵額外稅負，將廣泛推升整體通膨並壓抑經濟活動。能源淨進口地區如歐洲、日本與台灣等亞洲主要經濟體受創將最為嚴重。在央行受制於通膨、財政政策抵銷能力有限下，金融環境極易出現急遽收緊，投資人宜留意大宗商品避險配置以分散風險。
paras_en: The global energy supply is facing a highly fragile moment, with the three critical geographical nodes of the Persian Gulf, the Red Sea, and the Black Sea being blocked simultaneously. According to the latest report from PIMCO, a well-known fixed-income asset management institution, the cumulative loss of global oil supply has exceeded 1 billion barrels due to the impact of multiple geopolitical conflicts in the Middle East, Ukraine, and Russia, creating the largest energy supply net loss in history. As the buffer mechanism is gradually depleted, the fault tolerance of the global energy market has dropped to zero, and the market is facing a higher risk of global economic recession and stagflation-type supply shock. PIMCO pointed out that energy net-importing regions such as Europe, Japan, and Taiwan will be the most severely affected.

PIMCO economists Tiffany Wilding and Greg Sharenow, a commodities portfolio manager, analyzed that the current energy supply risk has expanded to the three critical geographical nodes of the Persian Gulf, the Red Sea, and the Black Sea. Among them, the shipping in the Persian Gulf is approaching a standstill, and the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has affected nearly 20% of the world's oil supply. The attack by the Houthi armed forces on the Mandab Strait in the Red Sea has hit the lifeline of Saudi Arabia's redirected oil exports to the Red Sea. The attack by Ukraine on Russia's refining facilities and export ports has caused Russia's processing volume to drop to its lowest level in over 20 years, further pushing up the premium of refined oil prices.

In addition to the crude oil market, gasoline, diesel, and aviation fuel, as well as liquefied natural gas (LNG), are also facing tight supply. Currently, the retail gasoline price in the United States has risen to over $4 per gallon, and diesel has exceeded $5. PIMCO emphasized that, in particular, the current global AI wave, with the explosive growth of computing power and data centers driving up electricity and energy demand, combined with the surge in demand from high-energy-consuming industries such as memory and chips, has further solidified and amplified the pressure of supply and demand imbalance in the energy market.

More troublesome is that the buffer mechanisms that used to mitigate market impacts have been nearly depleted. Global strategic oil reserves have released about 300 million barrels, causing the US strategic reserve to drop to a new low since 1983, and commercial inventories are also at a decades-low point. At the same time, China, the world's largest crude oil importer, has cut its purchases in half by drawing down its inventory and reducing imports. Once China re-enters the market to replenish its stock, the supply shortage problem will become even more acute.

PIMCO warned that this is a typical stagflation-type supply shock, and the substantial increase in energy prices is equivalent to imposing an additional tax on global consumers, which will broadly push up overall inflation and suppress economic activity. Energy net-importing regions such as Europe, Japan, and Taiwan, as well as other major Asian economies, will be the most severely affected. Under the circumstances where central banks are constrained by inflation and fiscal policy has limited offsetting capabilities, the financial environment is highly likely to tighten rapidly, and investors should be aware of the importance of diversifying risks through commodity hedging configurations.

items.title: 中國恐遭美最高「100%」關稅！美參院86票壓倒性通過制裁俄伊法案
items.title_en: China Faces Potential U.S. 100% Tariffs! Senate Passes Heavy‑Handed Sanctions Bill Against Russia and Iran by 86 Votes
paras: 美國參議院當地時間週五（7 日）以 86 票對 11 票的懸殊差距，通過一項名為《2026 年林賽 · 葛蘭姆制裁俄羅斯與伊朗法案》（S.5025）的重量級法案，授權對持續採購俄羅斯石油與天然氣的國家祭出高達 100% 的懲罰性關稅，由於中國長年是俄國能源出口最大買家之一，被外界視為此法案的主要瞄準對象。
這項法案由已故聯邦參議員葛蘭姆（Lindsey Graham）生前積極推動，在獲得白宮首肯後才得以在參院闖關成功。
根據法案內容，凡是全球採購俄羅斯原油或天然氣數量排名前五的國家，以及協助俄國規避現行能源制裁措施的前五大國家，其輸美商品都將面臨最重可達 100% 的關稅。
法案雖設有排除條款，允許進口俄國天然氣占俄國整體出口比重低於 15%、且已積極採取減量措施的國家申請豁免，但中國目前的採購比重遠遠超過這項門檻，難以適用此一例外規定。
此外，法案要求相關單位每 180 天重新檢視並更新「前五大買家」名單，同時保留總統一定的裁量空間，包括決定實際稅率高低，或以「符合國家利益」為由給予個別豁免。
除了鎖定能源買家的關稅條款外，法案同步祭出對俄羅斯官員、金融機構、能源相關項目以及所謂「影子船隊」的一級與二級制裁，並將現行的《伊朗制裁法》效期再延長 5 年。
法案通過參院後，接下來仍須經過眾議院表決，但由於國會目前處於休會期，最快須等到 9 月復會後才會排入議程審議，最終還需美國總統川普簽署才能正式生效。
值得留意的是，這項法案與美國過去對中國採取的貿易限制手段大不相同，因為過去的限制多半是針對特定產業、特定品項或特定企業精準施壓。
然而，這次法案一旦正式落地，將不分產業別、不分商品類別，對中國輸往美國的所有商品「一律加徵」最高 100% 關稅，形同全面性的「無差別打擊」，堪稱是美方迄今提出、涵蓋範圍最廣、潛在殺傷力最大的對中貿易限制工具之一。
不過，由於法案後續仍須經過眾議院審議與總統簽署兩道關卡，且授權川普一定的彈性裁量空間，法案最終能否如期生效、實際稅率高低，仍有待 9 月後國會復會的進一步觀察。
paras_en: On Friday (the 7th) local time, the U.S. Senate overwhelmingly approved the “2026 Lindsey Graham Sanctions on Russia and Iran Act” (S.5025) by a vote of 86 to 11, authorizing punitive tariffs of up to 100% on countries that continue to purchase Russian oil and gas. Because China has long been one of Russia’s biggest energy buyers, it is seen as the primary target of the bill.
The legislation was championed by the late Senator Lindsey Graham and only moved forward after receiving the White House’s blessing.

The bill stipulates that the top five global purchasers of Russian crude oil or natural gas, as well as the top five countries that help Russia evade existing energy sanctions, will see their U.S. imports subject to tariffs as high as 100%.

Although the bill contains an exemption for nations whose imports of Russian natural gas represent less than 15% of Russia’s total exports and that are actively reducing those imports, China’s share far exceeds that threshold, making the exemption inapplicable.

The legislation also requires relevant agencies to review and update the “top five buyers” list every 180 days, while preserving a degree of presidential discretion to set actual tariff rates or grant individual waivers in the name of “national interest.”

Beyond the tariff provisions on energy buyers, the bill simultaneously imposes first‑ and second‑tier sanctions on Russian officials, financial institutions, energy‑related projects and the so‑called “shadow fleet,” and extends the current Iran Sanctions Act for another five years.

After clearing the Senate, the bill still must pass the House of Representatives. Because Congress is currently in recess, the earliest it could be scheduled for a vote is after it reconvenes in September, and it will require President Trump’s signature to become law.
It is noteworthy that this bill differs markedly from previous U.S. trade restrictions on China, which typically targeted specific industries, products, or companies with precision pressure.

If enacted, the bill would impose a uniform tariff of up to 100% on all Chinese goods shipped to the United States, regardless of industry or product category—a sweeping, non‑discriminatory strike that would be one of the broadest and most potentially damaging trade‑restriction tools the U.S. has proposed against China.

However, because the measure still faces House approval and the President’s signature, and because it grants Trump considerable discretionary flexibility, whether it will take effect as intended and what the actual tariff rates will be remain uncertain pending further congressional action after the September session.

items.title: 少數飆股Q3續當領頭羊？法人揭密：股市集中化將洗牌 長線看好電力3領域
items.title_en: A Few Stocks Led the Market in Q3, But the Concentration Will Be Reversed, with a Long-Term Focus on Three Power-Related Fields
paras: 今年第三季以來，全球股票市場正面臨績效集中度大幅提升、價格波動幅度與速度顯著加快的雙重考驗。M&G 英卓股票、多元資產與永續發展投資長費碧安（Fabiana Fedeli）表示，當前企業不僅獲利豐厚且成長迅猛，但能持續維持高獲利的企業數量卻顯著減少。少數個股主導大盤的局勢僅是暫時，M&G 英卓建議投資人透過「精選個股」進行布局，團隊正策略性看好「電氣化」、「電力基礎設施」及「賦能型工業技術」等三領域的長線投資機會。

少數個股貢獻大部分漲幅 波動成新常態

費碧安指出，當前股市表現的集中程度令人驚嘆。以美國市場為例，今年上半年標普 500 指數 10.2% 的總報酬中，有高達 80% 僅由 13 檔個股所貢獻；亞洲市場同樣呈現高度集中，MSCI 亞太區（除日本）指數上半年上漲 23.9%，其中約 80% 的漲幅僅由該指數 1,048 檔成分股中的 3 家公司所帶動。
同時，個股價格在數周內快速翻倍、隨後又大幅回落的「極端震盪」現象，已成為當前市場的主要特徵。包含密集且全天候的資訊傳播、敘事驅動的量化交易，以及散戶活躍參與衍生性商品市場，都是推升股價劇烈震盪與集中度走高的結構性主因。

AI 引領資本支出潮 集中現象屬暫時性

儘管人工智慧（AI）創造出前所未有的營收與獲利成長，吸引市場資金高度簇擁，但費碧安認為，雖然 AI 本身是改變工作與生活的結構性力量，但資本集中於少數 AI 受惠股的現象卻極可能是暫時性的。
隨著供應瓶頸出現、資本支出步調放緩或產能調適等因素影響，部分企業將難以持續達成符合市場的高預期，股價終將回歸現實。歷史經驗顯示，定義當前週期的企業，未必能繼續定義下一個週期，市場領頭羊的身份終將「洗牌」。

主動精選個股 尋找定價失衡機會

面對極端集中化的市場，轉向市值型被動投資未必是最佳解答。費碧安建議，投資人應透過主動投資與精選個股，尋找定價失衡的投資機會。分散投資並非隨機橫跨各個產業，而是慎選價格與內在價值存在顯著差距的證券。
在具體選股主題上，除了持續看好具備成熟商業模式與穩定現金流的關鍵 AI 基礎設施供應商，團隊正將目光投向電氣化、電力基礎設施及賦能型工業技術等長期需求主題。此外，跨足能源、工業、醫療保健、金融及消費品等積極導入 AI 應用的非科技類股，以及日本企業轉型、歐洲能源安全與中國科技龍頭等區域性標的，亦蘊含深具吸引力的長期價值。
paras_en: Since the third quarter of this year, the global stock market has faced a dual challenge of significantly increased performance concentration and significantly increased price volatility and speed. Fabiana Fedeli, Head of Equity, Multi-Asset, and Sustainable Investment at M&G, stated that while companies are currently profitable and growing rapidly, the number of companies that can maintain high profitability is significantly decreasing. The situation where a few stocks dominate the market is only temporary, and M&G suggests that investors should invest through "selecting individual stocks" and strategically look to the long-term investment opportunities in "electrification", "power infrastructure", and "enabling industrial technology".

A few stocks have contributed to most of the gains, and volatility has become the new normal. Fedeli pointed out that the current market performance is highly concentrated. For example, in the US market, 80% of the total return of the S&P 500 index in the first half of the year came from just 13 stocks. The Asian market also showed high concentration, with about 80% of the 23.9% increase in the MSCI Asia Pacific (excluding Japan) index in the first half of the year driven by just three companies out of the 1,048 constituent stocks.

At the same time, the phenomenon of individual stock prices doubling in a few weeks and then falling sharply, known as "extreme fluctuations", has become a major characteristic of the current market. Factors such as intensive and all-day information dissemination, narrative-driven quantitative trading, and active participation of retail investors in derivative markets are the structural reasons for the sharp fluctuations and high concentration of stock prices.

Although artificial intelligence (AI) has created unprecedented revenue and profit growth, attracting a high concentration of market funds, Fedeli believes that the concentration of capital in a few AI-related stocks is likely to be temporary. As supply bottlenecks, capital expenditure slowdown, or production adjustments affect some companies, they will find it difficult to continue meeting the market's high expectations, and their stock prices will eventually return to reality.

Historical experience shows that the companies that define the current cycle may not continue to define the next cycle, and the market leaders will eventually be "reversed". As the supply chain bottlenecks and capital expenditure slow down, the concentration of the market will be reversed, and the leaders will change.

In the face of an extremely concentrated market, switching to a passive investment approach may not be the best solution. Fedeli suggests that investors should actively invest and select individual stocks to find opportunities with pricing imbalances. Diversified investment is not about randomly crossing various industries but rather carefully selecting securities with significant price and intrinsic value differences.

In terms of specific stock selection themes, in addition to continuing to look at key AI infrastructure providers with mature business models and stable cash flows, the team is also focusing on long-term demand themes such as electrification, power infrastructure, and enabling industrial technology. Furthermore, non-tech stocks that actively introduce AI applications in energy, industry, healthcare, finance, and consumer goods, as well as regional targets such as Japanese corporate transformation, European energy security, and Chinese tech leaders, also have attractive long-term value.

items.title: A股掀美IEEPA關稅違憲退稅潮！貴州輪胎單家到帳8136萬人民幣 千億級退稅已達六成
items.title_en: A‑shares surge on wave of US IEEPA tariff‑unconstitutionality refunds! Guizhou Tire records 81.36 million RMB, trillion‑level refunds hit 60%
paras: 貴州輪胎上周四 (6 日) 表示，旗下境外全資子公司 NACTR 陸續收到美國《國際緊急經濟權力法》(IEEPA)「對等關稅」退稅，累計退回關稅及利息 1198.30 萬美元(關稅本金 1152.66 萬、利息 45.64 萬)，約 8135.87 萬元(人民幣，下同)，擬計入 2026 年當期損益、不溯及以前年度。
這筆錢並非普通稅務優惠，而是美國最高法院推翻 IEEPA「對等關稅」後的歷史性大退稅的一角。
今年 2 月 20 日，美最高法院在 Learning Resources v. Trump 案以 6 比 3 裁定 IEEPA 未授權總統徵收大規模關稅，川普政府據此加徵的關稅自始無效。
國際貿易法院 3 月 4 日下令美國海關退款，隔月 20 日正式上線 CAPE 合併退稅系統，5 月 11 日前後首批放款。
根據上周二 (4 日) 法庭文件披露，美國海關已退還約 1000 億美元，佔 IEEPA 項下 1650 億美元已徵稅額的 60%，超 1280 億美元退稅申請受理中，涵蓋約 33 萬進口商，為美國最大規模關稅退稅。
上月以來，A 股上市公司東箭科技已獲退稅 339.27 萬美元 (約 2304 萬人民幣)、開能健康 454.93 萬美元、鴻合科技新線美國 407.20 萬美元、華海藥業壽科健康 1422.96 萬美元，格力博、華寶新能等亦推進申報退稅。
中國世紀證券指出，設有美國子公司 / 自主品牌者可直退增厚現金流；代工企業則受惠進口商補貨與議價壓力減弱，出口鏈情緒壓制鬆動。
必須注意的是，退稅僅限 IEEPA 違憲部分，不含 301、232 及反傾銷反補貼稅；且屬非經常性損益，不改主業基本面。貴州輪胎 8136 萬一次性入帳雖抬升年報利潤，本業仍須剔除該項。
千億退稅洪流正重塑中美貿易帳本，但法律反覆與後續行政繞道（如改引貿易法 122 條）風險未除。
paras_en: Guizhou Tire said on Thursday (the 6th) that its wholly‑owned overseas subsidiary NACTR has been receiving refunds under the US International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) “reciprocal tariff” scheme, totalling $11.983 million in duties and interest (principal $11.5266 million, interest $0.4564 million), roughly ¥81.3587 million, which it plans to recognise in the 2026 profit‑and‑loss statement without retroactive effect.
This money is not a routine tax break but a slice of the historic massive refund that followed the US Supreme Court’s overturning of the IEEPA “reciprocal tariff”.

On February 20 this year, the US Supreme Court ruled 6‑3 in Learning Resources v. Trump that IEEPA does not empower the President to impose large‑scale tariffs, rendering the tariffs added by the Trump administration void from the start.
The International Trade Court ordered US Customs to issue refunds on March 4, and on March 20 the CAPE consolidated refund system went live, with the first disbursements made around May 11.

According to court filings disclosed on Tuesday (the 4th), US Customs has already refunded about $100 billion, representing 60% of the $165 billion in duties collected under IEEPA, with more than $128 billion in refund applications pending, covering roughly 330,000 importers – the largest tariff‑refund programme in US history.

Since last month, A‑share listed firms have secured refunds such as Dongjian Technology ($3.3927 million, about ¥23.04 million), Kaoneng Health ($4.5493 million), Honghe Technology New Line US ($4.072 million) and Huahai Pharmaceutical Shoukē Health ($14.2296 million); Greebo, Huabao New Energy and others are also advancing their refund claims.

China Century Securities notes that companies with US subsidiaries or own brands can receive direct refunds that boost cash flow, while contract manufacturers benefit from reduced replenishment pressure and weaker bargaining power of importers, easing export‑chain sentiment.

It should be noted that the refunds apply only to the unconstitutional portion of IEEPA and do not include duties under Sections 301, 232 or anti‑dumping/anti‑subsidy taxes; they are non‑recurring items and do not change the core fundamentals of the business. Guizhou Tire’s one‑time ¥81.36 million entry lifts annual profit, but the core operation must still be evaluated without this item.

The trillion‑level refund wave is reshaping the US‑China trade ledger, yet legal back‑and‑forth and subsequent administrative work‑arounds (such as invoking Trade Act §122) mean the risk picture is not fully cleared.

items.title: 繼巨大護盤之後 自行車廠明係10日起執行買回1000張庫藏股
items.title_en: Bicycle manufacturer Ming Hsi to buy back 1,000 shares from October 10th
paras: 繼巨大 (9921-TW) 之後，自行車廠明係 (6804-TW) 也決議在每股 23 元以下，自 10 日起執行買 1000 張庫藏股護盤，用途在於轉讓給員工，巨大與明係的買回庫藏股，都是掛牌以來的首度執行。
明係決議自 10 日起執行的買回庫藏股措施，將在每股 23-16 元買 1000 張張庫藏股，股價低於 16 元元也得繼續買進，如買滿 1000 張，將占股本的 2.11%。
明係在 7 日通過 2026 第二季營收 36.4 億元，毛利率 13.94%，季增 5.73 個百分點，年增 6.56 個百分點，稅後純益 977 萬元，季增 32.15%，較去年同期由虧轉盈，單季每股純益 0.21 元。
明係 2026 年上半年營收 7.84 億元，毛利率 10.88%，年增 3.5 個百分點，稅後純益 1717 萬元，較去年同期由虧轉盈，每股純益 0.38 元。
而在日前提前完成執行買回 4000 張庫藏股的巨大，平均買回每股價格爲 71.75 元，占股本比重 1.02%。
巨大 2026 年第二季營收重返成長軌道，營收達 166.7 億元，年增 5.8%，毛利率 24.2%， 第二季單季稅後稅後純益 6.3 億元，大幅年增 2.34 倍，單季每股純益 1.62 元，2026 年上半年營收 291.9 億元，毛利率 22.3%，年增 3.2 個百分點，稅後純益 4.35 億元，上半年每股純益 1.11 元。
paras_en: Following Giant (9921-TW), bicycle manufacturer Ming Hsi (6804-TW) has also decided to buy back 1,000 shares at a price below NT$23 per share, starting from October 10th, for the purpose of transferring them to employees. This is the first time both Giant and Ming Hsi have implemented a share buyback since their listing.

Ming Hsi's share buyback, which will start on October 10th, will involve purchasing 1,000 shares at a price between NT$23 and NT$16 per share. If the share price falls below NT$16, the company will continue to buy shares. Once 1,000 shares are purchased, they will account for 2.11% of the company's total shares.

On the 7th, Ming Hsi announced its second-quarter revenue for 2026, which was NT$3.64 billion, with a gross margin of 13.94%. This represents a quarterly increase of 5.73 percentage points and a yearly increase of 6.56 percentage points. The company's net profit after tax was NT$97.7 million, up 32.15% from the previous quarter, and it turned a profit from a loss in the same period last year. The earnings per share for the quarter were NT$0.21.

In the first half of 2026, Ming Hsi's revenue was NT$7.84 billion, with a gross margin of 10.88%, which is a yearly increase of 3.5 percentage points. The company's net profit after tax was NT$171.7 million, turning a profit from a loss in the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$0.38.
Giant, which recently completed its buyback of 4,000 shares ahead of schedule, had an average buyback price of NT$71.75 per share, accounting for 1.02% of its total shares.

Giant's second-quarter revenue for 2026 returned to a growth trajectory, reaching NT$16.67 billion, a yearly increase of 5.8%. The company's gross margin was 24.2%, and its net profit after tax for the quarter was NT$630 million, a significant increase of 2.34 times from the same period last year. The earnings per share for the quarter were NT$1.62. In the first half of 2026, Giant's revenue was NT$29.19 billion, with a gross margin of 22.3%, a yearly increase of 3.2 percentage points, and a net profit after tax of NT$4.35 billion, with earnings per share of NT$1.11 for the first half of the year.

items.title: 印能科技卡位雙陣營 今年營收估倍增、產能再增3成
items.title_en: InnoTech Positions Itself in Dual Camps, Revenue Expected to Double This Year, Capacity to Increase by Another 30%
paras: 印能科技 (7734-TW) 持續擴大客戶版圖，近期除受惠台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) CoWoS 及 SoIC 等需求放量，也傳出深耕多年的英特爾 (INTC-US) EMIB 平台開始出貨，隨著兩大晶圓代工陣營同步推進先進封裝，印能科技今年營運可望逐季走高，法人估，印能今年營收將翻倍，明年動能可望再更強。
印能科技目前設備月產能約 40 台，為因應客戶需求持續升溫，已啟動新一波擴產計畫，將原先廠房三樓空間建置為生產區，月產能可望增加約 10 多台，整體產能提升約 30-40%。
印能科技近年隨著台積電 CoWoS 製程產能不斷擴張，營收高速成長，且受惠台積電未來持續穩健擴充產能，印能需求也跟著提升，同時也傳出切入 SoIC 供應鏈，使用印能第三代設備，今年下半年已開始陸續出貨。
市場預估，台積電今年 SoIC 產能將在短短三年內增長 3 倍，今年底月產能約 2 萬片，明年可望倍增至 4 萬片，後年更上看 8 萬片，受惠客戶逐步拉升產能，印能相關設備明年放量幅度將更顯著。
隨著全球先進封裝產能緊俏，英特爾 EMIB 製程也獲得多家終端客戶青睞，傳出拿下多筆訂單，並啟動未來數年擴產計畫，印能科技耕耘 EMIB 製程多年，相關設備已在今年上半年少量出貨，後續可望隨英特爾 EMIB 產品推進而逐步放量，成為新動能。
除了既有先進封裝技術，印能科技也積極切入 CPO、FOPLP 及翹曲控制等新應用，尤其近來由於晶片及光罩尺寸持續放大，翹曲問題也成為新挑戰，印能科技推出 WSAS 產品因應，目前已在客戶驗證階段，最快第四季有機會取得進展。
paras_en: InnoTech (7734-TW) continues to expand its customer base. Recently it has benefited from increased demand for TSMC (2330-TW) (TSM-US) CoWoS and SoIC, and it is reported that the long‑time Intel (INTC-US) EMIB platform it has been cultivating is now shipping. As both major wafer‑foundry camps push advanced packaging forward, InnoTech’s operations are expected to rise quarter by quarter this year. Analysts estimate InnoTech’s revenue will double this year, with even stronger momentum anticipated next year.

InnoTech’s current equipment capacity is about 40 units per month. To meet rising customer demand, it has launched a new expansion phase, converting space on the third floor of its plant into a production area. This should add roughly ten more units per month, boosting total capacity by about 30‑40%.

In recent years, as TSMC’s CoWoS production capacity has continuously expanded, InnoTech’s revenue has grown rapidly. Benefiting from TSMC’s steady capacity expansion, demand for InnoTech’s equipment has risen, and the company is also reported to have entered the SoIC supply chain, using its third‑generation equipment, with shipments beginning in the second half of this year.

The market forecasts that TSMC’s SoIC capacity will triple within three years. By the end of this year, monthly capacity is expected to reach about 20,000 wafers, doubling to 40,000 wafers next year and potentially 80,000 wafers the year after, as customers gradually increase output. Consequently, InnoTech‑related equipment is expected to see a more pronounced volume increase next year.

With global advanced‑packaging capacity in short supply, Intel’s EMIB process has attracted multiple end‑customers, securing several orders and launching a multi‑year expansion plan. InnoTech has been developing EMIB technology for years, and its related equipment saw limited shipments in the first half of this year. Further volume growth is expected as Intel’s EMIB products advance, providing a new growth driver.

Beyond existing advanced‑packaging technologies, InnoTech is actively entering new applications such as CPO, FOPLP, and warp control. As chip and mask sizes continue to grow, warp has become a fresh challenge. InnoTech introduced its WSAS product to address this and is currently in customer verification, with the possibility of progress as early as the fourth quarter.

items.title: 記憶體大漲推升顯示卡迎第三波漲價潮 板卡廠平均出貨單價激增進補
items.title_en: Memory Surge Drives Third Wave of GPU Price Hikes, Board Makers See Average Shipment Prices Jump
paras: 由於記憶體價格持續走揚，顯示卡市場迎來今年第三波漲價潮，輝達等晶片大廠陸續調漲顯示卡晶片套裝售價約 2-3 成，帶動全球零售通路與批發市場價格急劇攀升，可望進一步推升華碩 (2357-TW)、微星 (2377-TW)、技嘉 (2376-TW) 等板卡廠平均出貨單價，為下半年獲利表現注入補丸。
全球最大電子產品批發市場深圳華強北近期出現顯卡價格一日一價急漲現象，部分熱門與高階型號數日內上漲人民幣數百元至上千元，漲幅超過三成，甚至連二手市場價格也同步走高，顯卡製造商微星已正式跟進華碩與技嘉腳步調高顯示卡出貨價格，最高調漲幅度突破 20%。
針對記憶體成本大漲對後市的影響，微星表示雖然記憶體供貨能見度僅約一個月且成本攀升，導致今年消費性市場出貨量可能下滑 10% 至 20%，但在同業嚴控毛利率不殺價且單價提升帶動下，對整體獲利表現仍有實質幫助。
技嘉則指出記憶體價格上漲確實對消費端需求造成壓力，但隨著人工智慧應用持續普及，將有效推升既有電腦設備的換機需求，下半年主機板與顯示卡業務展望仍保持審慎樂觀。
雖然研究機構預警記憶體合約價下半年仍有大幅上揚風險，且晶片原廠針對部分高成本高階顯卡採取延後上市或調整產能策略，但各板卡廠積極嚴控產品毛利率並隨時調整產品報價，市場預期價格調整效應將持續觀察至年底購物旺季，整體高附加價值產品組合將持續支撐板卡廠營運韌性。
paras_en: Due to the continued rise in memory prices, the graphics‑card market is experiencing its third wave of price hikes this year. Major chip makers such as Nvidia are gradually raising the price of GPU chip packages by about 20‑30%, which has sent retail and wholesale prices soaring worldwide and is expected to lift the average shipment price for board makers like Asus (2357‑TW), MSI (2377‑TW) and Gigabyte (2376‑TW), bolstering profit performance in the second half of the year.

Shenzhen’s Huaqiangbei, the world’s largest electronics wholesale market, has recently seen GPU prices jump dramatically day by day. Some popular and high‑end models have risen by several hundred to over a thousand yuan within a few days, an increase of more than 30%. Even second‑hand market prices have climbed. GPU maker MSI has officially followed Asus and Gigabyte in raising its shipment prices, with the highest increase exceeding 20%.

Regarding the impact of the memory cost surge, MSI said that although memory supply visibility is only about a month and costs are climbing, which could cause consumer‑market shipments this year to fall 10‑20%, the industry’s strict control of gross margins and the rise in unit prices will still provide a tangible boost to overall profitability.

Gigabyte noted that the memory price rise does put pressure on consumer demand, but the continued proliferation of artificial‑intelligence applications will effectively drive replacement demand for existing computer equipment. Consequently, the outlook for motherboard and GPU sales in the second half remains cautiously optimistic.

Although research firms warn that contract memory prices could still rise sharply in the second half and chip makers are delaying launches or adjusting capacity for some high‑cost, high‑end GPUs, board makers are tightly managing product gross margins and adjusting pricing as needed. The market expects price‑adjustment effects to be monitored through the year‑end shopping season, and the overall high‑value‑added product mix will continue to support the resilience of board makers’ operations.

items.title_en: Founder of Yonghe Soy Milk, Lin Bing-sheng, Passes Away at Age 70
paras: 永和資本集團董事局 8 日（周六）發布訃告，宣布董事局主席、永和豆漿創始人林炳生，因病醫治無效，不幸於 7 日中午 12 時 45 分在台北安詳逝世，享壽 70 歲。
林炳生是永和資本集團奠基創始人，創立永和豆漿，深耕實業數十載，帶領集團布局大健康產業、股權投資、產業併購，開拓海外 SPAC 上市業務，搭建起多元化規範化的產業體系。
業界和外界素以「豆哥」尊稱，評價其「活出自己的精彩，是照亮別人的燈塔」。
永和資本集團董事局表示，為妥善處置後續事宜，經決定：治喪期間，集團總部及各下屬機構全面簡化商務活動，全員肅穆致哀。追悼儀式具體安排，後續另行通告。
集團各項經營工作由董事局統籌銜接，平穩過渡，全體員工堅守崗位，恪盡職守，確保集團業務穩定有序發展，接續傳承先生畢生事業與治企初心。
paras_en: Yonghe Capital Group's board announced on Saturday the 8th that its chairman and Yonghe Soy Milk founder Lin Bing-sheng, after unsuccessful treatment for an illness, peacefully died at 12:45 p.m. on the 7th in Taipei, aged 70.

Lin Bing-sheng, the founding pillar of Yonghe Capital Group, established Yonghe Soy Milk and devoted decades to industry, steering the group into the health sector, equity investments, corporate mergers and acquisitions, and expanding overseas SPAC listings, building a diversified and standardized industrial ecosystem.
He was affectionately known in the industry and beyond as “Soybean Brother,” praised for “living his own brilliance and serving as a lighthouse that illuminates others.”

The board stated that to properly handle subsequent matters, it has decided that during the mourning period the group’s headquarters and all subsidiaries will fully simplify business activities and observe solemn mourning; details of the memorial service will be announced later.

All operational matters of the group will be coordinated by the board to ensure a smooth transition, with staff remaining at their posts, fulfilling their duties, and guaranteeing stable, orderly development of the business while continuing to uphold the founder’s lifelong mission and corporate philosophy.

items.title: 志聖H1獲利創新高EPS達 7.16元  7月營收以11.68億元再登頂
items.title_en: Zhi Sheng H1 Profit Hits Record High, EPS Reaches NT$7.16; July Revenue Tops NT$1.168 billion
paras: PCB 及半導體廠志聖工業 (2467-TW) 今 (8) 日公布 2026 年最新營收資訊，2026 年 7 月營收以 11.68 億元再登頂，也是繼 5 月營收以 10.22 億元突破單月營收 10 億元大關後的另一重大突破。同時，志聖上半年稅後純益 11.06 億元，年增 2.09 倍，每股純益 7.16 元。
志聖 2026 年第二季營收 27.83 億元，自結單季稅後純益 6.4 億元，季增 37.33%，單季每股純益 4.1 元。志聖 2026 上半年自結營收 50.44 億元，較去年同期成長 78.92%；歸屬母公司業主稅後純益 11.06 億元，年增 2.09 倍，每股純益 7.16 元
屬台積電 (2330-TW) 供應鏈的志聖表示，2026 年營運主要受惠於先進封裝與先進 PCB 兩大成長動能。隨 AI 及高效能運算需求持續擴大，Foundry 與 OSAT 客戶持續增加先進封裝資本支出，帶動相關設備需求成長；先進 PCB 方面，IC 載板與 HLC 高階多層板業者亦大幅擴增資本支出，推升設備接單及出貨動能。
在 2026 年第一季，志聖來自半導體產業營收占比已達 50%，顯示公司轉型布局持續深化。單看第二季，營收 27.83 億元，季增 23.04%；稅後純益 6.4 億元，季增 37.33%，年增 2.09 倍。展望後市，志聖看好 AI 基礎建設帶動先進封裝與先進 PCB 投資需求，對後續成長維持樂觀看法。
paras_en: PCB and semiconductor manufacturer Zhi Sheng Industrial (2467‑TW) announced on July 8 its latest 2026 revenue figures. July 2026 revenue reached NT$1.168 billion, marking another peak after May’s NT$1.022 billion, which broke the NT$1 billion monthly threshold. For the first half of the year, net profit after tax was NT$1.106 billion, up 2.09‑fold year‑over‑year, translating to earnings per share of NT$7.16.

Zhi Sheng’s July 2026 revenue of NT$1.168 billion grew 34.33% month‑over‑month and 1.32‑times year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑July was NT$6.212 billion, already surpassing the full‑year 2025 revenue of NT$6.102 billion, an increase of 87.05% year‑over‑year.

In Q2 2026, Zhi Sheng posted revenue of NT$2.783 billion and a quarterly net profit after tax of NT$640 million, up 37.33% quarter‑over‑quarter, with quarterly EPS of NT$4.10. For the first half of 2026, revenue reached NT$5.044 billion, a 78.92% increase from the same period last year, and net profit attributable to the parent company was NT$1.106 billion, up 2.09‑fold year‑over‑year, yielding EPS of NT$7.16.

Zhi Sheng, a supplier in TSMC’s (2330‑TW) ecosystem, said its 2026 operations were mainly driven by two growth engines: advanced packaging and advanced PCBs. As AI and high‑performance computing demand expands, foundry and OSAT customers are increasing capital expenditures on advanced packaging, boosting equipment demand; in the advanced PCB segment, IC substrate and high‑layer‑count (HLC) high‑end multilayer board makers are also significantly raising capex, fueling equipment orders and shipments.

In Q1 2026, revenue from the semiconductor sector accounted for 50% of Zhi Sheng’s total, indicating deepening of its transformation strategy. In Q2, revenue of NT$2.783 billion rose 23.04% quarter‑over‑quarter, and net profit after tax of NT$640 million grew 37.33% quarter‑over‑quarter, a 2.09‑fold year‑over‑year increase. Looking ahead, Zhi Sheng is optimistic that AI infrastructure will continue to drive investment demand for advanced packaging and advanced PCBs, maintaining a positive outlook for future growth.

items.title: 宏致Q2純益成長近1倍上半年EPS1.89元 7月營收再創新高
items.title_en: Macroblock Q2 Profit Grows Nearly 1 Times Year-on-Year, EPS 1.89 in the First Half of the Year, 7 July Revenue Sets a New High
paras: 連接器廠宏致 (3605-TW) 第二季純益較前季及去年同期成長近 1 倍、7 月營收創下單月新高，本周買盤先行卡位，股價最高衝上 113 元創 16 年新高價，周漲 36%。
宏致第二季營收 33.50 億元，年增 20%、營業淨利 2.46 億元，年增 26%；稅後淨利 2.01 億元，年增 98%，每股純益 1.22 元，上半年每股純益來到 1.89 元。
宏致 7 月營收 11.54 億元，創下單月歷史新高紀錄，月增 3 %、年增 30 %；累計前 7 月營收 73.26 億元，年增 17%。公司表示，受惠 AI 伺服器需求強勁，帶動相關產品出貨比重顯著提升，帶動營運表現。
展望下半年，宏致表示，隨客戶新平台進入量產階段、拉貨動能全面升溫，相關高速高功率產品營收比重將持續擴大，訂單能見度清晰，帶動整體營運展現逐季強勁成長的趨勢。
paras_en: Macroblock (3605-TW) saw its second-quarter profit grow nearly 1 times year-over-year and 7 July revenue set a new high. The stock price reached a new high of NT$113, a 16-year high, with a weekly increase of 36%.

Macroblock's second-quarter revenue was NT$33.50 billion, up 20% year-over-year, with operating net income of NT$2.46 billion, up 26% year-over-year. After-tax net income was NT$2.01 billion, up 98%, with earnings per share of NT$1.22. The company's earnings per share for the first half of the year was NT$1.89.

Macroblock's 7 July revenue was NT$11.54 billion, setting a new historical high. The revenue increased by 3% month-over-month and 30% year-over-year. The company's cumulative revenue for the first 7 months was NT$73.26 billion, up 17% year-over-year. The company stated that it benefited from strong demand for AI servers, which drove the proportion of related products sold to increase significantly, driving operating performance.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, Macroblock stated that as customers' new platforms enter the production stage, the momentum of inventory replenishment will continue to rise, and the proportion of high-speed, high-power product revenue will continue to expand. The visibility of orders is clear, driving the overall operating performance to show a strong growth trend quarter by quarter.

items.title: 藥華藥更新AOP仲裁案第二階段結果 研議聲請撤銷仲銷判斷
items.title_en: YaoHua Pharma Updates Second-Stage Outcome of AOP Arbitration Case, Considers Request to Annul Arbitration Judgment
paras: 藥華藥 (6446-TW) 今 (8) 日針對與 AOP 的仲裁案召開重訊記者會，指出於昨 (7) 日接獲國際商會 (ICC) 的第二階段仲裁判斷，經過公司評估，此次仲裁判斷對財務及業務並無重大影響。
藥華藥指出，ICC 於 2025 年 2 月 17 日做出第一階段仲裁判斷，認定公司延遲的部分，已依法提起撤銷仲裁，目前由德國聯邦最高法院審理中。
針對第二階段仲裁判斷，藥華藥說明，此次仲裁庭認定 AOP 應向藥華藥支付 2019 至 2023 年上半年積欠的貸款及權利金，共超過 1700 萬歐元。
至於藥華藥延遲 5 個月取得歐洲藥證，以及延遲 4.5 個月的供貨爭議，在與 AOP 積欠貨款及權利金相抵後，仲裁庭分別裁定金額為 3131 萬 9250.27 歐元，以及 3456 萬 1864 歐元。
針對 2019 至 2021 年藥品採購價格爭議，仲裁庭裁定，藥華藥須退還 3160 萬 1477.5 歐元，並按照基礎利率 5%，最高不超過 6% 的年利息。
藥華藥重申，目前仲裁庭對公司業務無重大影響，針對此案的應對措施，公司將研議聲請撤銷仲裁判斷事宜。
此外，針對 AOP 發出的新聞稿，藥華藥聲明，AOP 所稱的藥華藥積欠上億歐元，以及 6500 萬歐元應收款項，均為 AOP 單方推算，並非仲裁判斷裁定內容。而 AOP 稱藥華藥超收 900% 超額定價，僅涉及 2019 至 2021 特定期間的貨款計算。
藥華藥提醒，有關與 AOP 仲裁案相關進度，請依照公開資訊觀測站揭露的訊息為主。
paras_en: YaoHua Pharma (6446-TW) held a press conference today (the 8th) regarding the arbitration case with AOP, stating that it received the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) second‑stage arbitration ruling yesterday (the 7th) and, after company assessment, the ruling has no material impact on its finances or operations.

The company noted that the ICC issued its first‑stage arbitration ruling on February 17, 2025, finding that YaoHua Pharma’s delay was subject to a lawful request for annulment, which is now being reviewed by the German Federal Supreme Court.

Regarding the second‑stage ruling, YaoHua Pharma explained that the tribunal determined AOP must pay YaoHua Pharma the overdue loans and royalties for the first half of 2019 through 2023, amounting to more than €17 million.

Concerning YaoHua Pharma’s five‑month delay in obtaining the European drug certificate and the 4.5‑month supply dispute, after offsetting these amounts against AOP’s overdue payments and royalties, the tribunal awarded €31 319 250.27 and €34 561 860 respectively.
On the drug‑price dispute for 2019‑2021, the tribunal ordered YaoHua Pharma to refund €31 601 471.5 and to pay interest at the base rate of 5%, not exceeding 6% per annum.

YaoHua Pharma reiterated that the arbitration decision does not materially affect its business and that the company will consider filing a request to annul the arbitration judgment as a response measure.

Furthermore, in response to AOP’s press release, YaoHua Pharma stated that AOP’s claim of the company owing over €100 million and a €65 million receivable is a unilateral calculation by AOP and not part of the arbitration ruling. AOP’s allegation that YaoHua Pharma overcharged by 900% pertains only to the specific period of 2019‑2021 for certain payments.
YaoHua Pharma reminded stakeholders that updates on the AOP arbitration case should be based on information disclosed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange’s public information platform.

items.title: 基金爆倉反成加分題？「AI股神」遭重創  矽谷投資人反而搶著押注
items.title_en: Fund’s Margin Call Turns Into a Plus? ‘AI Stock God’ Smashed, Yet Silicon Valley Investors Rush to Bet
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資圈近期爆發的槓桿危機，非但沒有澆熄矽谷對新世代 AI 投資人的熱情，反而出現意外的「逆勢追捧」。
前 OpenAI 研究員 Leopold Aschenbrenner 旗下避險基金 Situational Awareness 近期因高槓桿與集中持股遭遇流動性危機，甚至被迫大幅減碼股票部位。
不過，根據《彭博》報導，基金爆發危機後短短幾天內，多名矽谷投資人反而主動接觸該基金，表達追加資金的興趣。
知情人士透露，Situational Awareness 目前暫未接受新資金，但投資圈對 Aschenbrenner 的信心並未因此明顯動搖。
紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）合夥人 Pat Grady 甚至公開表示，他認為 Aschenbrenner 仍將是未來很長一段時間內矽谷的重要人物。
分析指出，這起事件也凸顯出矽谷與華爾街對「高風險、高報酬」投資模式截然不同的評價標準：華爾街看到的是槓桿、集中持倉與風險管理失控；矽谷部分投資人看到的，卻是一名押注 AI 長期趨勢的投資人，在遭遇挫敗後重新出發的機會。

槓桿危機引爆強制平倉　基金仍保有逾百億美元資產

Situational Awareness 此次危機的導火線，是融資機構要求追加保證金。
面對流動性壓力，基金緊急出售大部分股票持倉，並將相關部位出售給 Citadel 創辦人 Ken Griffin 旗下的 Citadel，折價幅度超過 10%。
這場拋售也讓市場迅速意識到，Aschenbrenner 原本高度集中的 AI 投資策略，可能因槓桿放大而面臨劇烈的下行風險。
Aschenbrenner 隨後向投資人承認投資策略出現錯誤，並宣布全面解除基金槓桿。他將此次事件形容為一場「代價高昂」的經驗，但同時強調，這些教訓將成為基金未來發展的重要資產。
儘管遭遇猛烈衝擊，Situational Awareness 目前剩餘資產，包括私募投資在內，總價值仍約 100 億美元；更值得注意的是，基金今年迄今仍錄得約 80% 的正報酬。

矽谷反而力挺　「英雄敘事」蓋過爆倉陰影

在傳統金融市場，基金爆倉通常會嚴重打擊經理人的聲譽；但 Aschenbrenner 的情況卻出現不同結果。
風險投資機構 Redpoint Ventures 董事總經理 Logan Bartlett 表示，矽谷存在一種特殊的「英雄原型」，Aschenbrenner 這次遭遇挫敗，反而讓部分支持者產生更強的凝聚力。
知名創投人士 Elad Gil 也公開表示，他已首次申請投資 Aschenbrenner 旗下基金。
紐約大學 Stern 商學院兼任教授、Focus Investment Group 董事總經理 Gygmy Gonnot 則認為，這種截然不同的反應，源自矽谷與華爾街衡量成功的方式不同。
對矽谷而言，只要投資人押中了足以改變產業格局的技術趨勢，即使過程中承擔巨大波動，也可能被視為值得；但對華爾街而言，核心仍是如何控制風險、保住本金，同時取得合理的風險調整後報酬。

華爾街早有疑慮　集中持股與高槓桿成最大警訊

然而，從華爾街角度來看，Situational Awareness 此次遭遇的危機並非完全出乎意料。
S3 Partners 創辦人 Bob Sloan 直指，這檔基金同時具備高度集中、交易擁擠以及高槓桿三項特徵，而這三種風險一旦同時出現，很容易在市場反轉時形成連鎖反應。
事實上，在基金此次危機爆發之前，部分大型金融機構就已對其風險結構有所疑慮。
與許多成熟避險基金不同，Situational Awareness 的主要投資者是舊金山灣區的富裕個人與家族辦公室，而非大型退休基金或主權財富基金。
《彭博》先前報導指出，巴克萊在基金危機爆發前數週，曾以單一產業曝險過度集中為由，拒絕將 Situational Awareness 納入主經紀業務客戶。
據悉，摩根士丹利最初也曾因 Aschenbrenner 投資經驗不足而拒絕提供主經紀服務，但知情人士透露，該銀行後來改變態度，計畫在未來數週內與 Situational Awareness 建立主經紀關係。
另一方面，高盛、摩根大通與美國銀行則曾向該基金提供槓桿資金。

AI 基金成為高報酬競技場　7 月拋售潮放大風險

分析指出，Situational Awareness 所處的 AI 專注型避險基金市場，本身就是一個高報酬與高波動並存的戰場。
部分競爭對手同樣取得驚人績效。例如 Value Aligned Research Advisors 由來自貝萊德（BlackRock）與 Hudson River Trading 等機構的資深人士組成，截至 6 月底管理資產規模超過 260 億美元。
根據《彭博》取得的投資人文件，該公司旗下 AI 基金今年截至 6 月底的報酬率約 194%，同期標普 500 指數漲幅則不到 10%，兩者差距極為懸殊。
但高報酬同樣伴隨高風險。7 月 AI 類股遭遇拋售時，多家大型避險基金也受到衝擊。Millennium Management 當月下跌 2.1%，Point72 Asset Management 下跌 3.3%，而持股更為集中的 Altimeter Capital Management 則重挫 11%。
部分投資人甚至提前預判 Situational Awareness 可能遭遇強制拋售，並預先建立避險部位。

去槓桿只是第一步　Aschenbrenner 下一關仍是華爾街

分析人士認為，對 Aschenbrenner 而言，此次危機真正的考驗可能不是如何重新獲得矽谷投資人的支持，而是如何重新取得華爾街金融機構的信任。
他已宣布清除基金所有槓桿，現階段也不再透過銀行主經紀業務放大投資部位。
然而，問題在於，若希望重現今年早期的超高報酬，單靠自有資金可能限制投資規模與策略彈性。換言之，未來若要再次大舉押注 AI，Aschenbrenner 最終仍可能需要重新取得銀行融資與槓桿支持。
分析稱，這使他陷入一個微妙的局面。一方面，矽谷投資人仍相信他押注 AI 的長期眼光；另一方面，華爾街則會要求他證明自己能夠控制槓桿、降低持倉集中度，並建立更成熟的風險管理制度。
paras_en: The recent leveraged crisis erupting in the AI investment circle has not dampened Silicon Valley’s enthusiasm for the next‑generation AI investors; instead, it has sparked an unexpected “counter‑trend rally.”

Leopold Aschenbrenner, a former OpenAI researcher, runs the hedge fund Situational Awareness, which recently ran into a liquidity crunch because of high leverage and a concentrated stock portfolio, forcing the fund to dramatically cut its equity positions.
According to Bloomberg, within just a few days of the fund’s crisis, several Silicon Valley investors proactively reached out to the fund, expressing interest in adding capital.
Sources familiar with the matter say Situational Awareness has not yet taken new money, but confidence in Aschenbrenner within the investment community has not visibly wavered.
Sequoia Capital partner Pat Grady even publicly stated that he believes Aschenbrenner will remain a key figure in Silicon Valley for a long time to come.

Analysts note that the episode highlights the starkly different standards Silicon Valley and Wall Street apply to “high‑risk, high‑reward” investing: Wall Street sees leverage, concentration and loss of risk control; some Silicon Valley investors see a person betting on the long‑term AI trend who, after a setback, now has a chance to restart.
Leverage crisis triggers forced liquidation – the fund still holds over $10 billion in assets. The spark for Situational Awareness’s latest trouble was a margin call from its financing partners.
Facing liquidity pressure, the fund hurriedly sold most of its equity holdings, offloading the positions to Citadel, the firm founded by Ken Griffin, at a discount of more than 10 %.
The sell‑off quickly made the market aware that Aschenbrenner’s highly concentrated AI strategy could suffer severe downside risk when leverage amplifies losses.

Aschenbrenner later admitted to investors that the investment approach was flawed and announced a full unwind of the fund’s leverage. He described the episode as a “costly” learning experience, but stressed that the lessons will become valuable assets for the fund’s future development.
Despite the shock, Situational Awareness still has roughly $10 billion in assets left, including private‑equity holdings, and it has posted about an 80 % positive return year‑to‑date.

Silicon Valley backs the fund – the “hero narrative” overshadows the margin‑call shadow. In traditional finance, a fund’s collapse usually damages a manager’s reputation, but Aschenbrenner’s case has produced a different outcome.

Redpoint Ventures managing director Logan Bartlett said there is a special “hero archetype” in Silicon Valley, and Aschenbrenner’s setback has actually strengthened cohesion among some of his supporters.
Prominent venture investor Elad Gil also publicly announced that he has filed his first investment request for Aschenbrenner’s fund.
Gygmy Gonnot, a professor at NYU Stern and managing director of Focus Investment Group, believes the divergent reactions stem from the different ways Silicon Valley and Wall Street measure success.

For Silicon Valley, as long as an investor backs a technology trend that could reshape an industry, even massive volatility may be deemed worthwhile; Wall Street, however, remains focused on risk control, capital preservation, and achieving reasonable risk‑adjusted returns.
Wall Street had long harbored doubts – concentration and high leverage were the biggest red flags. From Wall Street’s perspective, the crisis at Situational Awareness was not entirely unexpected.

Bob Sloan, founder of S3 Partners, pointed out that the fund combined three risk factors – high concentration, crowded trading and high leverage – and when they appear together they can trigger a chain reaction in a market reversal.
In fact, before the crisis erupted, several large financial institutions had already raised concerns about the fund’s risk structure.
Unlike many mature hedge funds, Situational Awareness’s primary investors are wealthy individuals and family offices in the San Francisco Bay Area, not large pension funds or sovereign wealth funds.
Bloomberg previously reported that Barclays, weeks before the fund’s crisis, refused to onboard Situational Awareness as a prime brokerage client, citing excessive single‑industry exposure.

It is understood that Morgan Stanley initially declined to provide prime brokerage services because of Aschenbrenner’s limited investment experience, but insiders say the bank later changed its stance and plans to establish a prime brokerage relationship in the coming weeks.
On the other hand, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America have all provided leveraged financing to the fund.

AI funds have become a high‑return arena – July sell‑offs amplified risk. Analysts note that the AI‑focused hedge‑fund market, where Situational Awareness operates, is inherently a battlefield of high returns and high volatility.

Some competitors have also posted eye‑popping performance. For example, Value Aligned Research Advisors, staffed by veterans from BlackRock, Hudson River Trading and other firms, managed over $26 billion in assets as of the end of June.

According to investor documents obtained by Bloomberg, the AI fund run by that firm posted a roughly 194 % return through June, while the S&P 500 rose less than 10 % over the same period – a stark contrast.

But high returns come with high risk. When AI stocks were sold off in July, several large hedge funds felt the impact: Millennium Management fell 2.1 %, Point72 Asset Management dropped 3.3 %, and the more concentrated Altimeter Capital Management plunged 11 %.
Some investors even pre‑emptively predicted that Situational Awareness might face a forced liquidation and built hedges in advance.

De‑leveraging is only the first step – Aschenbrenner’s next hurdle remains Wall Street. Analysts say the real test for Aschenbrenner is not merely winning back Silicon Valley backing, but regaining the trust of Wall Street financial institutions.
He has announced that all leverage has been removed from the fund and that it no longer uses prime‑brokerage financing to amplify positions.

However, the problem is that if he wants to replicate the ultra‑high returns seen earlier this year, relying solely on internal capital may limit the size and flexibility of his strategies. In other words, a future large‑scale AI bet may still require renewed bank financing and leverage support.

Analysts say this puts him in a delicate position. On one hand, Silicon Valley investors still believe in his long‑term AI vision; on the other, Wall Street will demand proof that he can control leverage, reduce concentration, and build a more mature risk‑management framework.

items.title: 波克夏財報亮眼淨利暴增111%！阿貝爾上任「積極」、由「淨賣方」轉為「淨買方」
items.title_en: Berkshire Hathaway's Earnings Soar 111% as Abel Takes the Helm
paras: 波克夏 (BRK.A-US、BRK.B-US) 週六（8 日）公布最新財報，第二季在股票投資組合帳面獲利大幅回升的帶動下，稅後淨利達到 256.67 億美元，較去年同期的 123.70 億美元成長逾一倍；上半年累計淨利 357.73 億美元，年增率約 111%。這份成績單讓外界觀察到，接任執行長一職的阿貝爾（Greg Abel），正逐步展現與巴菲特（Warren Buffett）時代不同的資金運用節奏。
這波獲利大增主要來自投資收益的貢獻。波克夏第二季稅後投資收益達 126.84 億美元，其中股票部位未實現獲利增加約 109 億美元，另有約 18 億美元的已實現獲利入帳。
相較之下，去年同期因卡夫亨氏 (KHC-US) 投資認列 37.60 億美元減損，重壓了當季獲利表現。
值得一提的是，儘管卡夫亨氏股權的帳面價值目前仍高於市價逾一成，波克夏管理層評估後認為尚未觸及減損門檻，因此本季未再提列相關損失。
撇開投資收益的波動，公司核心的營業利潤同樣穩健成長，第二季達 129.83 億美元，年增約 16%；上半年營運利潤合計 243.29 億美元，成長約 17%。
細看各業務板塊，製造、服務暨零售部門表現最為亮眼，單季貢獻 44.70 億美元，年增達 24%；鐵路子公司 BNSF 貢獻 15.58 億美元，年增約 6%；能源事業則交出 8.91 億美元，成長逾 27%。
相對於實體業務的熱絡，波克夏向來倚重的保險本業則出現降溫跡象。保險承保利潤下滑至 17.31 億美元，保險投資收益也較去年同期減少近 10%。
不過，受惠於美元計價債務匯兌收益由虧轉盈，「其他」類別項目意外挹注 12.74 億美元獲利，成為本季報表中的一大亮點。

一口氣買進近 200 億美元股票，Google 躍居五大重倉

財報最受矚目的焦點，莫過於波克夏罕見地由「淨賣方」轉為「淨買方」。
第二季公司淨買進股票約 198 億美元，其中包含斥資約 100 億美元建立 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 普通股部位，讓 Google 一舉躋身波克夏五大持股之列，並取代雪佛龍 (CVX-US) 的席次。
在與蘋果 (AAPL-US) 、美國運通 (AXP-US) 、美國銀行 (BAC-US) 、可口可樂 (KO-US) 並列後，這五大重倉股合計已占整體股票投資組合 66% 的比重。
值得玩味的是，這筆重倉佈局的時間點，恰好緊接在阿貝爾親自主導、協助 Alphabet 敲定一筆 850 億美元規模融資案之後，顯示這位新任掌舵者在推動大型交易時，出手節奏相當明快。
進一步檢視上半年整體交易，波克夏共買進股票 394.05 億美元、賣出 277.80 億美元，淨買超約 116.25 億美元；相較之下，去年同期還是淨賣出約 45 億美元的狀態。
分析指出，這代表波克夏已正式告別過去數年持續縮減持股、囤積現金的保守姿態，轉向公開市場的積極加碼。
截至 6 月底，波克夏權益類投資公允價值達 3237.79 億美元，較年初增加 260 億美元，帳面浮盈更高達 2172.58 億美元。
除了加碼股市，波克夏第二季同步斥資 45.27 億美元買回自家股票，創下自 2021 年以來單季最大規模的股東回饋，遠高於第一季僅 2.35 億美元的水準；上半年合計回購金額約 47.6 億美元。
觀察月度節奏，波克夏 4 月幾乎沒有動作，5 月才開始小幅進場，到了 6 月則明顯加速，單月即買回逾 714 萬股 B 股（均價約 487.98 美元）以及 413 股 A 股（均價約 73.38 萬美元）。
阿貝爾今年稍早曾對外表示，公司重新啟動庫藏股計畫，是因為管理層判斷波克夏股票的「內在價值」已高於市場交易價格。

波克夏兩筆逾百億元收購案，現金儲備明顯縮水

大手筆加碼股市與回購的同時，波克夏的帳上現金也隨之下滑，截至 6 月 30 日，現金儲備降至 3655 億美元。
除了市場操作，波克夏上半年還完成兩筆重量級實體收購：一月初，公司以約 94 億美元收購西方石油旗下化工業務 OxyChem，並已於第二季開始貢獻約 14 億美元營收；；7 月下旬，波克夏再以每股 72.5 美元、總對價約 68 億美元的現金收購美國知名住宅建商 Taylor Morrison。
分析人士指出，在高利率壓抑房市買氣之際仍出手收購建商，反映出阿貝爾對美國住宅需求長線前景的信心。
綜合來看，兩筆收購合計動用現金約 162 億美元，加上股票淨買超 116 億美元與庫藏股 48 億美元，波克夏在阿貝爾主導下的資本配置腳步，正明顯較過去加快。
paras_en: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A-US, BRK.B-US) reported a significant increase in earnings for the second quarter, driven by a substantial rise in investment gains. Net earnings reached $25.67 billion, more than double the $12.37 billion reported in the same period last year. For the first half of the year, net earnings totaled $35.77 billion, representing a year-over-year increase of 111%.

The significant increase in earnings was primarily driven by investment gains. Berkshire Hathaway's second-quarter net investment gains totaled $12.68 billion, with unrealized gains on equity investments increasing by approximately $10.9 billion and realized gains totaling around $1.8 billion.
In contrast, last year's second quarter was negatively impacted by a $3.76 billion impairment charge related to Kraft Heinz (KHC-US) investments.

Notably, despite Kraft Heinz's stock being valued at over 10% above market price, Berkshire Hathaway's management team assessed that the impairment threshold had not been reached, and therefore did not recognize any further losses in the current quarter.

Excluding investment gains, Berkshire Hathaway's core operating earnings also showed a steady increase, reaching $12.98 billion in the second quarter, representing a year-over-year increase of 16%. For the first half of the year, operating earnings totaled $24.32 billion, representing a year-over-year increase of 17%.

Breaking down the performance by business segment, manufacturing, services, and retail showed the most impressive results, contributing $4.47 billion in the quarter, representing a year-over-year increase of 24%. BNSF Railway contributed $1.56 billion, representing a year-over-year increase of 6%, while the energy segment showed a year-over-year increase of over 27%.

In contrast, Berkshire Hathaway's insurance business, which has historically been a key component of the company's operations, showed a decline in earnings. Insurance underwriting profits decreased to $1.73 billion, and investment gains in the insurance segment were lower by around 10% compared to the same period last year.
However, the company benefited from a reversal of dollar-denominated debt exchange gains, which added $1.27 billion to the 'other' category, making it a significant highlight in the quarterly report.
The most attention-grabbing aspect of the report was Berkshire Hathaway's rare shift from a net seller to a net buyer of stocks.

In the second quarter, the company bought approximately $19.8 billion worth of stocks, including a $10 billion investment in Alphabet (GOOGL-US) common stock, which propelled Google into Berkshire Hathaway's top five holdings, displacing Chevron (CVX-US).
Alongside Apple (AAPL-US), American Express (AXP-US), Bank of America (BAC-US), and Coca-Cola (KO-US), these five stocks now account for 66% of the company's total equity portfolio.

Notably, this significant stock allocation was made shortly after Abel personally led and assisted Alphabet in securing an $85 billion financing deal, demonstrating the new CEO's swift action in driving large transactions.

Looking at the company's overall trading activity for the first half of the year, Berkshire Hathaway bought $39.4 billion worth of stocks and sold $27.78 billion, resulting in a net buying position of $11.62 billion. In contrast, the company was a net seller of $4.5 billion in the same period last year.

Analysts point out that this represents a significant shift away from the company's conservative stance of reducing holdings and accumulating cash over the past few years, and towards a more aggressive approach of actively investing in the market.
As of June 30, Berkshire Hathaway's equity investments had a fair value of $32.37 trillion, up $26 trillion from the beginning of the year, and book value increased to $21.72 trillion.

In addition to increasing its equity investments, Berkshire Hathaway also repurchased $4.57 billion worth of its own shares in the second quarter, the largest quarterly repurchase since 2021, exceeding the $235 million repurchased in the first quarter.

Looking at the monthly rhythm, Berkshire Hathaway was relatively inactive in April, began to make small purchases in May, and accelerated its buying in June, purchasing over 714,000 B shares (average price around $487.98) and 413 A shares (average price around $73.38 million).
Abel had previously stated that the company was restarting its stock buyback program because management believed the company's stock had an intrinsic value higher than its market price.
While Berkshire Hathaway was actively buying stocks and repurchasing its own shares, its cash reserves also declined, falling to $36.55 trillion as of June 30.

In addition to market operations, Berkshire Hathaway completed two significant M&A deals in the first half of the year: a $9.4 billion acquisition of OxyChem, a chemical business owned by Occidental Petroleum, and a $6.8 billion cash acquisition of Taylor Morrison, a well-known US homebuilder.
Analysts point out that the company's willingness to invest in a homebuilder despite the current housing market slowdown reflects Abel's confidence in the long-term demand for US housing.

In summary, the two M&A deals combined used approximately $162 billion in cash, in addition to the $116 billion net buying position and $48 billion in stock buybacks, demonstrating that Berkshire Hathaway's capital allocation under Abel's leadership is accelerating compared to the past.

items.title: 「SaaS末日」來了嗎？AI浪潮下軟體股表現兩極：誰獲勝、誰失敗一次看
items.title_en: Is the "SaaS Apocalypse" Here? Software Stocks Split in the AI Wave: Who Wins and Who Loses at a Glance
paras: 美股軟體類股本週財報季再度上演「幾家歡樂幾家愁」戲碼，市場對於人工智慧（AI）究竟會吃掉傳統軟體即服務（SaaS）業者的生意，還是反過來成為這些公司的成長引擎，看法愈趨分歧。
根據《Business Insider》報導，這波被外界稱為「SaaS 末日論」的疑慮，並未一視同仁地打擊所有軟體股，反而讓市場更精細地篩選出贏家與輸家，而週五（7 日）美股交易正好凸顯了這種分化。
企業協作工具商 Atlassian (TEAM-US) 、雲端通訊業者 Twilio(TWLO-US) 與客服中心軟體商 Five9 公布優於預期的財報後，週五收盤股價分別大漲 35.31%、24.89% 與 19.81%。
相較之下，行銷與客服軟體公司 HubSpot(HUBS-US) 週五收盤只上漲 3.96%。
分析人士指出，「AI 取代 SaaS」的敘事今年以來曾多次衝擊上述幾家公司股價，但隨著時間，市場逐漸看出更細膩的圖像：部分軟體公司握有較深的護城河，難以被輕易取代。
此外，許多業者也積極將 AI 功能整合進既有產品線，反而創造新的營收動能；至於個別公司股價的漲跌，往往還摻雜了各自獨特的營運變數。

Atlassian：執行長加碼買股 展現信心

旗下擁有 Jira、Confluence 等企業工作管理工具的 Atlassian，在財報大幅超越華爾街預期後，週五收盤大漲 35.31%。
公司第四季營收年增 28%，達 17.7 億美元，優於分析師預估的 16.6 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 1.87 美元，同樣勝過市場預期的 1.50 美元。
雲端業務營收則成長 31% 至 12 億美元。公司指出，雲端採用持續強勁，以及 AI 驅動的產品需求，是支撐未來展望的主要動能。
執行長 Mike Cannon-Brookes 向投資人表示，他計畫買進 2.5 億美元的 Atlassian 股票，以實際行動展現信心，認為公司有能力挺過「SaaS 末日」。

Twilio：AI 語音與訊息需求助攻 自由現金流創新高

雲端通訊平台公司 Twilio，週五收盤大漲 24.89%。
公司公布第二季營收 15 億美元，年增 22%，優於分析師預估的 14.3 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 1.47 美元，同樣超越市場預期的 1.32 美元。
值得注意的是，Twilio 單季自由現金流達 3.53 億美元，創下歷史新高。
公司對第三季營收的預測區間中值為 15.1 億美元，高於華爾街約 14.7 億美元的預估。管理層表示，AI 語音與訊息服務需求暢旺，帶動有機成長率加速至 17%。

Five9：AI 營收暴增 78% 但獲利能力承壓

雲端客服中心軟體商 Five9 財報表現溫和優於預期，週五收盤上漲 19.81%。不過，在盤前交易，Five9 股價僅小幅上漲約 1.7%。
公司第二季營收年增 10% 至 3.124 億美元，超越市場預估的 3.066 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 70 美分，也比市場預期高出約 2 美分。
細看財報內容，Five9 訂閱業務營收成長 14%，AI 相關營收更是暴增 78%，展現轉型動能。
不過，公司獲利能力出現隱憂，調整後毛利率從去年同期的 63% 收斂至 61.4%，調整後每股盈餘也較去年同期的 76 美分下滑至 70 美分。

HubSpot：財測不如預期 銷售週期拉長

以行銷、銷售與客戶服務軟體聞名的 HubSpo 週五收盤小幅上漲 3.96%，但仍難以挽回週四（6 日）暴跌 19% 的頹勢。
公司第二季營收年增 20% 至 9.117 億美元，優於市場預估的 8.983 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 3.26 美元，同樣勝過分析師預期的 3.02 美元。
然而，HubSpot 對第三季營收的財測低於華爾街預期。公司預估第三季營收將介於 9.24 億至 9.25 億美元，低於分析師約 9.41 億美元的預期，同時將全年營收財測中值下調了 2,200 萬美元。
執行長 Yamini Rangan 在財報電話會議上表示，定價與產品調整拉長了客戶的採購流程，而客戶預算趨於緊縮，也導致銷售週期延長。
財務長 Kate Bueker 表示，HubSpot 第二季新增 7,000 名客戶，低於公司原先預期的 9,000 至 1 萬名。
paras_en: U.S. software stocks again staged a "some celebrate, some worry" drama this week’s earnings season, as the market’s view diverges on whether artificial intelligence (AI) will eat away the business of traditional software‑as‑a‑service (SaaS) firms or become a growth engine for them.

According to Business Insider, the concern dubbed the "SaaS apocalypse" has not hit all software stocks uniformly; instead it has prompted the market to sift more finely for winners and losers, and Friday’s (the 7th) U.S. trading highlighted that split.

Enterprise collaboration tool maker Atlassian (TEAM‑US), cloud communications provider Twilio (TWLO‑US) and contact‑center software vendor Five9 all posted earnings that beat expectations, sending their shares up 35.31%, 24.89% and 19.81% respectively at Friday’s close.
By contrast, marketing and customer‑service software company HubSpot (HUBS‑US) rose only 3.96% at Friday’s close.

Analysts note that the narrative of "AI replacing SaaS" has knocked the stocks of the companies above several times this year, but over time the market is seeing a more nuanced picture: some software firms have deeper moats that are hard to erode.

Moreover, many players are actively embedding AI features into existing product lines, creating new revenue momentum; the price moves of individual stocks often also reflect each company’s unique operational variables.

Atlassian: CEO Increases Share Purchases to Show Confidence
Atlassian, which owns enterprise work‑management tools such as Jira and Confluence, saw its stock jump 35.31% after its earnings far exceeded Wall Street forecasts.
The company’s fourth‑quarter revenue grew 28% year‑over‑year to $1.77 billion, beating analysts’ estimate of $1.66 billion; adjusted earnings per share were $1.87, also ahead of the $1.50 consensus.
Cloud‑services revenue rose 31% to $1.2 billion. The firm said strong cloud adoption and AI‑driven product demand are the main drivers of its outlook.
CEO Mike Cannon‑Brookes told investors he plans to buy $250 million of Atlassian stock, using actual purchases to demonstrate confidence that the company can survive a "SaaS apocalypse."

Twilio: AI Voice and Messaging Demand Fuels Gains, Free Cash Flow Hits Record High
Cloud communications platform Twilio surged 24.89% at Friday’s close.
The company reported second‑quarter revenue of $1.5 billion, up 22% year‑over‑year and ahead of the $1.43 billion analysts expected; adjusted EPS was $1.47, also above the $1.32 forecast.
Notably, Twilio’s free cash flow for the quarter reached $353 million, a historic high.

For the third quarter, Twilio projects revenue around $1.51 billion, above Wall Street’s roughly $1.47 billion estimate. Management said strong demand for AI‑driven voice and messaging services is accelerating organic growth to 17%.

Five9: AI Revenue Soars 78% but Profitability Under Pressure
Contact‑center software provider Five9 posted modestly better‑than‑expected earnings, with its stock up 19.81% at Friday’s close. In pre‑market trading, the stock was up only about 1.7%.
Second‑quarter revenue grew 10% year‑over‑year to $312.4 million, topping the market’s $306.6 million estimate; adjusted EPS was $0.70, roughly $0.02 above expectations.
A deeper look shows Five9’s subscription revenue grew 14% while AI‑related revenue exploded 78%, highlighting transformation momentum.
However, profitability showed signs of strain, with adjusted gross margin narrowing from 63% a year ago to 61.4%, and adjusted EPS falling from $0.76 to $0.70 year‑over‑year.

HubSpot: Outlook Misses Expectations, Sales Cycle Lengthens
HubSpot, known for marketing, sales and customer‑service software, rose only 3.96% at Friday’s close, still unable to recover from a 19% plunge on Thursday (the 6th).
Second‑quarter revenue rose 20% year‑over‑year to $911.7 million, beating the $898.3 million consensus; adjusted EPS was $3.26, also above the $3.02 forecast.

Nevertheless, HubSpot’s third‑quarter revenue guidance fell short of Wall Street’s expectations. The company forecast Q3 revenue between $924 million and $925 million, below analysts’ roughly $941 million estimate, and trimmed the midpoint of its full‑year revenue outlook by $22 million.
CEO Yamini Rangan said in the earnings call that pricing and product adjustments have lengthened customers’ purchasing cycles, and tighter budgets have also extended the sales cycle.
CFO Kate Bueker noted that HubSpot added 7,000 new customers in Q2, below the company’s original expectation of 9,000 to 10,000.

items.title: 蘋果正式牽手阿里！Apple Intelligence整合「千問」　Siri可直接調用
items.title_en: Apple Partners with Alibaba: Apple Intelligence Integrates 'Qwen' Model, Siri Can Directly Call
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 與阿里巴巴 (09988-HK) 的人工智慧（AI）合作，如今已不再只是傳聞或監管文件上的字眼，而是實際寫進了蘋果官方的產品說明之中。
近日有網友發現，蘋果中國官網的《Mac 使用手冊》新增一個頁面，標題直白寫著「在 Mac 上配合蘋果智慧使用通義千問」。
這代表，阿里的大型語言模型「千問」已正式成為中國版 Apple Intelligence 系統中不可或缺的一環。
根據蘋果的說明，千問並非以獨立應用程式的形式出現在使用者眼前，而是深度嵌入 Apple Intelligence 的核心功能。
舉例來說，當 Siri 無法完整回答某些較複雜的提問時，系統會在背後呼叫千問來補強回覆內容，包括對照片與文件進行深入分析；在蘋果的寫作工具中，使用者同樣可以透過千問，依文字描述生成文字或圖像內容。
換句話說，多數使用者可能根本不需要主動開啟千問 App，只要在日常使用 Siri 提問、分析文件或啟動 AI 寫作功能時，就有機會在不知不覺間用上這套中國本土模型的運算能力。
事實上，蘋果與阿里的合作早有跡象可循。今年七月，《路透》報導指出，Apple Intelligence 相關的生成式 AI 服務已完成中國監管部門的備案程序；為符合中國市場法規要求，蘋果選擇同時與阿里巴巴、百度 (BIDU-US) 合作，其中阿里的千問模型將被整合進 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 與 visionOS 等多個系統平台。
《華爾街日報》稍早也曾報導，蘋果自 2025 年初便著手推進相關監管程序，並與阿里、百度共同開發針對中國市場設計的 AI 功能。
不過，此前外界所知多半停留在「誰與蘋果合作」的層面。這次官方使用手冊的更新，則首度將合作內容具體落實到使用者體驗上。
Siri 能調用千問，寫作工具也能調用千問，這代表千問所獲得的，並不僅僅是「預裝 App」的位置，而是切入了蘋果系統最核心的 AI 入口。
分析指出，這起合作背後，反映的是蘋果 AI 策略的一次根本轉向。
過去的智慧型手機時代，蘋果向來習慣將核心軟體能力牢牢握在自己手中：晶片自行設計、作業系統自行開發、Siri 也是自家產品。
然而，進入生成式 AI 時代後，大型模型更新速度飛快、訓練成本居高不下，加上各國監管與資料規範差異極大，蘋果因此開始將 Apple Intelligence 打造成更具彈性的分層架構。
在最底層，蘋果仍仰賴自研的 Apple Silicon 晶片與裝置端模型處理大量個人化任務，並持續強調裝置端運算對隱私保護的重要性；但當使用者提出的問題較為複雜、需要更強大的模型能力時，系統便會轉而呼叫外部模型支援。
這種做法蘋果在海外市場其實已有先例，如今則將角色交棒給中國本土 AI 廠商。
也就是說，蘋果正嘗試建立一條全新的「AI 供應鏈」：自己掌控作業系統、硬體與使用者入口，底層模型能力則依市場需求選擇不同供應商。

對阿里而言：比裝進 iPhone 更重要的位置

對阿里巴巴來說，這次合作的意義同樣深遠。
分析指出，過去一年，中國大型模型市場競爭日趨白熱化，各家廠商不僅比拚模型能力, 更積極爭奪使用者入口。
阿里自家的千問 App 持續擴充辦公、生活服務、AI 代理與圖像影片生成等功能，試圖直接對消費者端發力。
然而，蘋果所提供的，卻是完全不同性質的入口。它不需要使用者特意想到「我要用 AI」再另外開啟應用程式，而是讓 AI 直接融入使用者原本就在使用的系統功能之中。
分析認為，這等於是把大型模型從一項獨立產品，轉化為作業系統背後的基礎能力。
值得一提的是，英國《金融時報》本週在分析阿里最新模型 Qwen 3.8-Max 時也指出，阿里正嘗試將 AI 打造為新的技術與商業成長引擎，阿里雲則在模型能力商業化過程中扮演關鍵角色。
若未來數以千萬計的中國蘋果裝置都能透過系統功能呼叫千問，阿里所獲得的將不只是龐大的調用量，更包含一項極具份量的產業背書，證明其大型模型有能力成為全球最大消費電子生態系之一的底層 AI 供應商。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) and Alibaba (09988-HK) have been collaborating on artificial intelligence (AI) projects, and this collaboration is no longer just a rumor or a regulatory filing, but is now officially written into Apple's product documentation.
Recently, a netizen discovered that Apple's official Chinese website has added a new page to the Mac user manual, titled 'Using Apple Intelligence with Qwen on Mac'.
This means that Alibaba's large language model, Qwen, has officially become an essential component of the Apple Intelligence system in China.
According to Apple's explanation, Qwen is not presented as a standalone application, but is deeply embedded in the core functionality of Apple Intelligence.

For example, when Siri is unable to fully answer a complex question, the system will call Qwen in the background to supplement the response content, including in-depth analysis of photos and files; in Apple's writing tools, users can also use Qwen to generate text or image content based on text descriptions.

In other words, most users may not need to actively open the Qwen app, but can use the Chinese native model's computing power in the background when using Siri to ask questions, analyze files, or activate AI writing functions.

In fact, Apple and Alibaba's collaboration has been evident for some time. In July, Reuters reported that Apple Intelligence-related generative AI services had completed the registration process with Chinese regulatory authorities; to meet the requirements of the Chinese market, Apple chose to cooperate with Alibaba and Baidu (BIDU-US) simultaneously, with Alibaba's Qwen model being integrated into iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS, among other system platforms.

The Wall Street Journal had previously reported that Apple had begun pushing related regulatory procedures as early as January 2025 and was working with Alibaba and Baidu to develop AI functions tailored for the Chinese market.

However, prior to this, most of the information known to the outside world was limited to 'who is cooperating with Apple.' This time, the official update of the user manual has brought the cooperation content to the user experience for the first time.

Siri can call Qwen, and the writing tool can also call Qwen, which means that Qwen's capabilities are not limited to being a 'pre-installed app,' but have entered the core AI entry point of the Apple system.
Analysts point out that this cooperation reflects a fundamental shift in Apple's AI strategy.

In the era of intelligent phones, Apple has always preferred to keep core software capabilities in its own hands: designing its own chips, developing its own operating systems, and Siri is also a self-owned product.

However, with the advent of generative AI, large models update at a rapid pace, training costs are high, and there are significant differences in regulations and data standards across countries, Apple has begun to transform Apple Intelligence into a more flexible, multi-layered architecture.

At the bottom layer, Apple still relies on its self-designed Apple Silicon chips and device-end models to handle a large number of personalized tasks, and continues to emphasize the importance of device-end computation for privacy protection; but when users ask complex questions that require more powerful model capabilities, the system will call external models for support.
This approach has already been seen in Apple's overseas markets, and now it is passing the baton to Chinese native AI vendors.
